notes.title: Playtest of Fall of the Mist will start this week end !
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This week end is an important step for Fall of the Mist! 

By applying to the playtest you will be able to play Fall of the Mist and give us feedback via Steam or Discord! And while we are at it, you can join our Discord where you will be kept updated! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895303/1ca11b50aef98997caa111be2aee9bff16a05533.png


Let's take a look at the content of this playtest !

While proceeding in this corrupted world, your equipment and deck will be your first priority . The ennemies will loot random pieces of equipment, but you will also have the opportunity to buy equipment and cards. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895303/ad4df9a145d6c20684ff90eec3d9f5ba2691e150.png

 You can combo your cards if they have a symbol in common.

[previewyoutube=il2lU-bIse4;full][/previewyoutube]
The Breviary will allow you to add the cards that you bought to your deck and reroll or delete any card of your deck. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895303/099b3404031b74d515eef90d5fba2e2c0eb5de38.png

Please keep in mind that the game is still at a very early stage and can include bugs, placeholders and/or imperfections.




https://store.steampowered.com/app/2832110/Fall_of_the_Mist/
